title: Repair filesystem data structures of a volume
summary: Check and repair the filesystem data structures of a specific volume. This can help fix minor disk errors.

steps.explain: Repair the filesystem data structures of the specified volume. Replace <DISK> with the identifier of the volume you want to repair (e.g., /dev/disk2s1).

placeholders.name: DISK
placeholders.description: The volume identifier to repair, e.g., /dev/disk2s1

steps.expect: Output indicating whether the volume was repaired successfully or if errors were found.

rollback.explain: There is no direct undo for a repair operation. If the repair fails or causes issues, you may need to restore from a backup or use Disk Utility's First Aid.

warnings: Ensure you have a backup of important data before repairing disk structures.
Do not interrupt the repair process once it has started.
